title: Berkeley Measure X Passed: What Changes for Landlords, and When

findings.quote: Now it's ten percent at a time, with the rest still banked for later.
findings.root_cause: The script switches from future effect to present operation and loses the rolling 12-month limit. FAQ labels the carry-forward reading as interpretation but the script does not.
findings.fix: Once Measure X takes effect, AGA-based increases will be limited to 10% in a 12-month period. Our reading is that unused amounts remain in the rent ceiling for later; confirm the available amount with the Rent Board.

findings.quote: And tenant associations can now form in self-managed buildings with five or more units.
findings.root_cause: Premature 'now'; the statutory test uses parcels, not individual buildings. Official PDF page 18 visually confirms both redline changes and preservation after a manager leaves.
findings.fix: Once the measure takes effect, tenants on self-managed parcels with five to nine rental units will become eligible to form an association under the ordinance. Professionally managed parcels already qualified at any size. An established association will also keep its rights if the management company leaves.

findings.quote: everything in this table except the 2027 AGA became law on November 3, 2026, pending certification.
findings.root_cause: Election day, declaration/adoption and effective date are conflated. The table even includes the unannounced effective date as something supposedly enacted.
findings.fix: Voters approved these amendments in the November 3 election, according to unofficial results. They are not yet in effect; the operative date remains to be confirmed. The 2027 AGA is a separate Rent Board determination. Also replace 'Before November 3' with 'Before Measure X takes effect' in the AEBP observation.

findings.quote: The change only reaches self-managed buildings with 5 to 9 units.
findings.root_cause: The threshold expansion is narrower than all changes to association rights; the survival provision also affects professionally managed parcels. See official ballot PDF page 18 and City Attorney analysis items 5–7.
findings.fix: The threshold expansion reaches self-managed parcels with five to nine rental units. Measure X also preserves an established association's rights if the property management company leaves. Rename the subsection 'Tenant associations: lower thresholds and continuing rights'.

findings.quote: the owner could serve one increase to about $2,811 (with 90 days' notice, since it's over 10%).
findings.root_cause: The example includes the 2027 AGA, unavailable before January 1; framed as a pre-effective-date action it suggests notice could defeat the future cap. Eligibility for 2023 is not established merely by saying rent reached its ceiling in 2022.
findings.fix: Without Measure X's new cap, the hypothetical 2027 ceiling would be about $2,811. This is a comparison of rules, not a suggestion that serving notice before the measure takes effect permits that January increase. Assume the tenancy began before 2022, rent was $2,500 at the end of 2022, and the unit remained eligible for every listed AGA.

findings.quote: One side effect: the 90-day notice path mostly goes away
findings.root_cause: The section needs the statutory aggregation/service assumptions and a source for mail timing; live LegInfo sections returned 403. Repo civ-827.txt confirms cumulative increases and longer contractual requirements, not an unconditional 30-day result.
findings.fix: For AGA-only increases that stay within 10% over the preceding 12 months, the ordinary statutory notice period is 30 days. Longer contractual or other applicable notice requirements still control. The November 25 mailing target assumes mailing within California and includes a conservative extra day. Before publication, verify Civil Code 827(b)-(c), CCP 1013(a), and Elections Code 9217 against an accessible official source and cite them.

findings.fix: Once the measure takes effect, tenants on self-managed parcels with five to nine rental units will become eligible to form an association under the ordinance. Professionally managed parcels already qualified at any size. An established association will also keep its rights if the management company leaves.

findings.root_cause: CORNERSTONE-STRUCTURE requires a Before You Act checklist. Technical gate also requires a Berkeley deep-dive link, absent in the draft; rendered schema and blocks could not be checked through anonymous draft URLs.
findings.fix: Before You Serve a Berkeley Rent Increase: Confirm coverage and tenancy eligibility; verify the registered ceiling, unused AGAs and prior 12-month increases; confirm Measure X's effective date; check registration, deposit interest, repair orders and lease limits; calculate notice and service time. Add a contextual link to the site's Berkeley rent-control deep-dive guide after resolving its live URL. Replace the video teaser's 'with chapter links and a full transcript' with 'with the draft script below' until production is complete. Validate rendered blocks, schema and media in authenticated preview.
